title: polystichum neozelandicum subsp. zerophyllum
intro: Polystichum neozelandicum subsp. zerophyllum, commonly known as New Zealand fern, is a subspecies of the Polystichum neozelandicum plant, a type of fern native to New Zealand. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum neozelandicum subsp. zerophyllum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effectiveness and safety of this plant for medicinal use.
